general: To be invited in a category round you must meet the minimum criteria of Express Entry, which means being eligible for one of its three programs (Federal Skilled Worker, Canadian Experience Class or Federal Skilled Trades), and meet every requirement in the instructions for that round.

categories.name: French-language proficiency
categories.requirement: French test results of NCLC 7 or higher in all four abilities (speaking, listening, reading, writing).

categories.name: Healthcare and social services occupations
categories.requirement: At least 12 months of full-time work experience (or the same amount part-time) in the last 3 years, in Canada or abroad, in one of the listed occupations. The months do not need to be continuous.

categories.name: Skilled military recruits
categories.requirement: Be a Foreign Skilled Military Applicant (FSMA): serving in a recognized foreign military, with at least 10 years of continuous service, and with work experience and training aligned with the main duties of one of the listed Canadian Armed Forces occupations. You also need an offer of arranged employment with the Canadian Armed Forces, made by the Canadian Forces Recruiting Group, for continuous full-time work in Canada of at least 3 years in one of those occupations, and at least a 2-year post-secondary credential (with an educational credential assessment if you studied outside Canada).
